item.title: Hisense HMC6MBK 7-in-1 Pressure Cooker 1000W

It is made for efficiency, speed and safety, and this versatile appliance handles multiple kitchen functions in one compact unit, saving you both time and energy. item.title: Abasi 5% EC 1 Litre
item.description: Abasi 5% EC (1 litre) Spider mites, thrips and leafminers are small, but they reduce yield and spoil the look of roses, tomatoes, cucumbers and French beans, which is what buyers pay for. Abasi 5% EC is an abamectin insecticide that kills by contact and stomach action and moves through the leaf (translaminar), so pests feeding on the underside are reached. It works at very low rates. KEY BENEFITS • Strong knockdown of mites and leaf-mining insects • Contact and stomach activity stops pests feeding quickly • Translaminar movement protects both leaf surfaces • Reliable on thrips and other small sucking pests • Cost-efficient: only 4 to 6 ml per 20 L knapsack TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredient: Abamectin 5% (50 g/L) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • IRAC group 6: activates glutamate-gated chloride channels, causing paralysis • Pack: 1 litre (also available in 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml and 1 L) • Crops and pests: thrips, spider mites and nematode dips on roses; spider mites and caterpillars on tomatoes; leafminers and aphids on cucumbers; leafminers, thrips, spider mites and aphids on French beans MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) Rate: 200 to 300 ml per hectare in 1,000 L of water, which is 4 to 6 ml per 20 L knapsack. A 1-litre bottle mixes about 166 to 250 knapsacks. 1. Half-fill the knapsack with clean water. 2. Add the measured Abasi, then top up to 20 L and agitate well. 3. Spray immediately after mixing, covering the undersides of leaves where mites and thrips hide. 4. Follow the repeat interval and harvest waiting period printed on your pack. SAFETY Toxic to bees and aquatic life, so avoid spraying during flowering or near water. Wear gloves, mask and overalls. Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying. WHAT'S IN THE BOX 1 × Abasi 5% EC (1 litre) ORDER Pay by M-Pesa. Delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi.

item.title: ALONZE 50EC Abamectin Insecticide 1 Litre
item.description: ALONZE 50EC Abamectin Insecticide (25 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml, 1 Litre) ALONZE 50EC is an abamectin insecticide, miticide and nematicide with contact and translaminar action. It controls spider mites, thrips and leaf miners on flowers and vegetables, and nematodes in potatoes. KEY SPECIFICATIONS & FEATURES • Active ingredient: Abamectin 50 g/L • Target: Spider mites in roses and carnations; thrips and leaf miners in vegetables; nematodes in potatoes • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Application settings: Agricultural: flowers, vegetables and potatoes MIXING & APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS 1. Dilution rate: Foliar spray: 0.15 L per hectare in 1000 L of water (3 ml per 20 L). Potato nematodes: soil drench of 240 to 300 ml per hectare in 1000 L of water. 2. Application method: Half-fill the tank with clean water, add the measured product, top up and agitate. Spray in calm weather with good coverage of leaf undersides, where mites and thrips hide. 3. Coverage: depends on the dose and spray volume on the label. Available in 25 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml and 1 Litre. 4. SAFETY & RE-ENTRY PRECAUTIONS • Wear gloves, a mask, goggles, overalls and boots when mixing and spraying. • Pre-harvest interval: chilies, broccoli and snow peas 7 days; runner beans, tomatoes and French beans 3 days; potatoes 14 days. Do not harvest before the interval has passed. • Re-entry period: 12 hours. Keep people, children and animals out of the sprayed area until the spray has dried, and follow the re-entry and pre-harvest intervals on the label. • Keep spray and rinse water away from streams, ponds and wells. Store in the original closed container, cool, dry and locked, away from food and feed. item.description: Zagro Ultraxide Disinfectant for Poultry & Livestock Farms (1 litre) One sick batch can wipe out a season's profit. item.title: Promax 20 EC Odourless Bed Bug Insecticide
item.description: Promax 20 EC Odourless Bed Bug Insecticide (50 ml sachet) Bed bugs (kunguni) hide in mattress seams, bed frames and skirting boards, then bite while you sleep. Promax 20 EC is a propoxur-based, odourless insecticide concentrate that you dilute and spray straight into those hiding places. It also tackles cockroaches (mende), fleas, ants and houseflies, so one pack protects your house, hostel, hotel room or office. Pay with M-Pesa and get it delivered countrywide. KEY BENEFITS • Odourless formulation suited to bedrooms and other indoor spaces (let surfaces dry fully) • Residual action on treated surfaces, so pests that crawl across later are still affected • Multi-pest: bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies • Concentrated: 25 ml makes 1 litre of ready-to-spray liquid • Works with any hand-pump or knapsack sprayer TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredient: Propoxur 20% w/v (carbamate insecticide) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Use: household and public-health crawling-insect control • Pack: 50 ml sachet • Mode of action: blocks nerve signal transmission, causing paralysis MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE • 1 L hand sprayer: 25 ml Promax 20 EC, top up with water to 1 L • 5 L garden sprayer: 125 ml, top up to 5 L • 20 L knapsack: 500 ml, top up to 20 L Most homes need only 1 to 5 L. The 20 L knapsack rate is for hotels, hostels and large premises. Always confirm the rate on your pack's label. One 50 ml sachet makes 2 litres of ready-to-spray liquid. 1. Half-fill the sprayer with clean water, add Promax, top up and shake well. 2. Spray mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards, cracks, behind sockets and furniture joints. 3. Wet surfaces lightly. Do not soak. 4. Bed bug eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if needed. SAFETY Keep children, pets and fish tanks out of the room until surfaces are dry and the room is ventilated. Do not spray food, utensils or bedding you will use before it dries. Wear gloves and wash hands after use. WHAT'S IN THE BOX 1 × Promax 20 EC (50 ml sachet) ORDER Pay by M-Pesa. Delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi.

item.title: Gradometer 480EC Termiticide
item.description: Gradometer 480EC Termiticide (1 Litre) Gradometer 480EC is a termiticide containing chlorpyrifos 480 g/L, supplied in a 1 litre bottle. It is used for treating timber, fencing poles and wooden structures, and for treating termite nests in lawns and gardens in Kenya. KEY FEATURES • Emulsifiable concentrate termiticide • Active ingredient: chlorpyrifos 480 g/L • For timber in buildings and construction, trees and fencing poles • For treating termite nests in lawns and gardens • 1 litre bottle • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Gradometer • Product: 480EC termiticide • Active ingredient: Chlorpyrifos 480 g/L • Pack size: 1 litre THE TERMITE PROBLEM Termites feed on wood, paper and other plant material. They can weaken roof timbers, door frames, fence posts and furniture before the damage is clearly visible. Lysine is an essential amino acid. Amino acids are the building blocks of protein, and animals cannot make lysine themselves, so it must come from the feed. In poultry and pigs, lysine is the amino acid that is most often short in cereal-based rations such as those made mostly with maize. When lysine is short, growth slows, feed conversion worsens and muscle development suffers. WHY ADD LYSINE TO RATIONS Adding lysine helps farmers and feed mixers balance rations so that animals get the amino acids they need. This can support growth, feed efficiency and meat yield in pigs and broilers, and egg production in layers. It also helps balance protein levels in feed formulations, which can help reduce the amount of protein-rich ingredients needed. WHERE IT IS USED • Poultry rations: chicks, broilers, growers and layers • Pig rations: weaners, growers and finishers The correct amount depends on the species, age, production level and the other ingredients in the ration. HOW TO USE IT Read and follow the label and inclusion rate before use. Add lysine to the ration at the rate recommended on the label or by your nutritionist or vet. Mix very thoroughly so that every animal receives an even amount, using a proper mixer or mixing in stages for small batches. Do not exceed the recommended rate. item.title: Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer
item.description: Greenlife Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife Jambo Clean is a foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew off crops while nourishing them. It contains water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% and total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% plus ammoniacal 1.5%). It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. KEY FEATURES • Foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew • Water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% • Total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% + ammoniacal 1.5%) • Feeds the crop while it cleans the leaves • 1 litre pack • Greenlife brand • Delivered to all 47 counties WHAT ARE HONEYDEW AND SOOTY MOULD? Sucking insects such as aphids, whiteflies and scale insects feed on plant sap and pass out a sticky, sugary liquid called honeydew. It covers leaves, stems and fruits. A black fungus called sooty mould then grows on the honeydew and forms a dark coating. The coating blocks light, so the plant cannot photosynthesise well, and it makes the crop look dirty, which can lower quality and market value, especially for flowers, vegetables and fruit. HOW JAMBO CLEAN HELPS Jambo Clean is sprayed on the crop to help clean off sooty mould and honeydew. At the same time, the nutrients in the product nourish the plant. This makes it a practical choice for growers who need to clean up their crops and give them a boost. WHAT THE NUTRIENTS DO • Nitrogen supports leaf growth and green colour. Here it comes partly as urea and partly as ammoniacal nitrogen • Phosphorus supports root development, flowering and energy transfer in the plant HOW TO USE IT Follow the dose, water volume, timing and interval given on the label. Mix in clean water, agitate, and spray evenly so that leaves are well covered. Spray in the cool of the morning or late afternoon and avoid the heat of the day to reduce the risk of leaf scorch. Test on a few plants first if you are using it on a crop for the first time. IMPORTANT: TREAT THE CAUSE TOO Sooty mould returns if the sucking insects are still there. Scout for aphids, whiteflies and scale and control them with a suitable insecticide, following its label. Good crop hygiene, ant control and removing badly affected leaves also help. SAFETY Read the label before use. Wear gloves and avoid contact with eyes and skin. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Do not let spray or rinse water reach streams or ponds. STORAGE Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. item.description: Kerol Disinfectant Fluid (1 Litre) Kerol Disinfectant Fluid has a Rideal-Walker coefficient of 18 to 20 and is a powerful disinfectant and insect repellent for livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use. It comes in a 1 litre pack and is diluted with water as directed on the label. KEY FEATURES • Rideal-Walker coefficient 18 to 20 • Powerful disinfectant • Also acts as an insect repellent • For livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use • Dilute with water before use • 1 litre pack • Delivered to all 47 counties WHAT THE RIDEAL-WALKER COEFFICIENT MEANS The Rideal-Walker coefficient is a traditional way of comparing the germ-killing strength of a disinfectant with phenol, which is given a value of 1. A coefficient of 18 to 20 means the fluid is many times stronger than phenol when tested under standard laboratory conditions, which is why it is described as a powerful disinfectant. Real results depend on dilution, contact time and how clean the surface is. WHERE IT IS USED • Livestock houses: cattle sheds, milking parlours, goat and sheep pens and pig sties • Poultry houses: brooders, layer and broiler houses, and equipment • Domestic use: floors, drains, toilets, bins and other places that need disinfecting WHY DISINFECTION MATTERS Germs build up where animals live and where waste collects. In the home, it helps keep drains, bathrooms and bins clean. HOW TO USE IT Dilute with water as directed on the label, using the correct amount for the job. Always clean first: remove manure, bedding, feed and dirt, wash with water and allow to drain, because disinfectants work best on clean surfaces. Then apply the diluted fluid by spraying, mopping or scrubbing, and give it enough contact time as stated on the label before rinsing, if required. item.title: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench 500 ml
item.description: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench (500 ml) Albafas is a 10% w/v albendazole drench for treating worms and liver fluke in cattle, sheep, goats and camels. It is supplied in a 500 ml bottle from Norbrook Kenya, and it is used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke. KEY FEATURES • 10% w/v albendazole, a broad-spectrum dewormer • For cattle, sheep, goats and camels • Used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke • 500 ml bottle • Made by Norbrook Kenya WHY WORM CONTROL MATTERS Internal parasites quietly drain animals. Heavily infected cattle, sheep, goats and camels grow slowly, lose condition, produce less milk and meat, and become more open to other diseases. Young animals are often the most affected. Regular, well-planned deworming protects growth and productivity and can save the cost of treating sick animals later. HOW TO USE IT Albafas is given by mouth as a drench. The dose depends on the animal species and body weight, so follow the dose on the label and use an accurate drenching gun. Weigh or estimate weight carefully, and dose the heaviest animal in a group at its own weight to avoid under-dosing. Under-dosing is one of the main causes of worms becoming resistant to dewormers. If you are not sure about the dose, the correct time to treat, or the withdrawal period for milk and meat, ask your vet or animal health provider. GOOD PRACTICE • Deworm on a programme agreed with your vet, rather than only when animals look sick • Keep clean water and good pasture management to reduce re-infection • Rotate dewormers from different groups when advised, to help slow resistance • Keep records of dates, products and doses SAFETY AND STORAGE For veterinary use. Follow the label dose and withdrawal periods. Wear gloves when handling and wash your hands afterwards. Keep out of reach of children. Store the bottle tightly closed in a cool, dry place away from direct sun and food. Do not let rinse water reach streams or ponds. ORDER Order Albafas 10% albendazole drench online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi.

item.title: BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer
item.description: Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC is a liquid chelated copper suspension concentrate fertilizer. It contains copper oxychloride 700 g/L, which is 400 g/L metallic copper equivalent, and it corrects and prevents copper deficiency in vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals. It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. KEY FEATURES • Liquid chelated copper fertilizer in suspension concentrate (SC) form • Copper oxychloride 700 g/L (400 g/L metallic copper equivalent) • Corrects and prevents copper deficiency • For vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals • 1 litre pack • Greenlife brand WHY COPPER MATTERS Copper is a trace element that plants need in small amounts. It plays a part in enzyme activity, in the formation of chlorophyll and in flowering, pollen formation and grain filling. When copper is short, plants can show stunted growth, pale or twisted young leaves, poor flowering and lower yields. Cereals are especially sensitive, and deficiencies are more common in sandy, peaty and very high-organic soils. HOW TO USE IT Apply as directed on the label, normally as a foliar spray, using the dose and water volume recommended for your crop. Mix by half-filling the tank with water, adding the measured product, topping up and agitating well. Spray evenly, covering the leaves. Apply when the crop is actively growing and at the stage recommended on the label, and spray early in the morning or late in the afternoon when it is cooler. If you are unsure whether copper is really short, consider a soil or leaf test to confirm. GOOD PRACTICE • Do not exceed the label rate, because too much copper can harm plants and soil • Avoid spraying in hot midday sun • Test a small area first if you plan to mix with other products • Keep records of dates and doses SAFETY Read the label before use. Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when mixing and spraying, and wash well afterwards. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Copper compounds can be harmful to fish and aquatic life, so keep spray and rinse water out of streams, ponds and drains. STORAGE Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. Shake well before use. ORDER Order BioDistinction Extra 700SC online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi.

item.title: Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with 6-Way Extension Socket
item.description: Buy the Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with a 6-way extension socket online in Kenya. Power cuts, sudden returns of electricity and low voltage are some of the most common reasons fridge compressors fail. This guard sits between your wall socket and your fridge or freezer, watches the supply, and cuts the power when it is unsafe so your appliance is not damaged. How it works: the guard has three indicator lights marked OFF, WAIT and ON. When the supply is unsafe it disconnects the appliance. When power returns, the guard waits for a short delay before switching back on, which gives the compressor time to settle. This protects against the damaging quick restart that often happens when electricity comes back after an outage. A bypass button lets you override the guard if you need to. The bundle also includes an Amaze 6-way extension socket with a long white cable and a UK-style plug, so you can power your TV, decoder, phone chargers and other small devices from a single wall point. The sockets are clearly spaced, and the cable is long enough to reach across most rooms. Who needs it: any household or small business with a fridge, freezer, water dispenser or display cooler. In areas where voltage drops or blackouts are common, a guard is a small cost compared with replacing a compressor or losing a freezer full of food, milk or drinks. Pack size: 1 Amaze fridge and freezer guard plus 1 Amaze 6-way extension socket with cable. Colour: white with blue label. Plug type: UK three-pin. Please check the rating printed on the guard against your appliance before you buy, and use the guard for refrigeration appliances as shown on its label. Installation is simple: plug the guard into the wall, plug your fridge into the guard, and wait for the ON light. No tools needed. Order today, choose pickup or delivery to your county, and pay with M-Pesa at checkout.

item.title: ALONZE 50EC Abamectin Insecticide 25 ml
item.description: ALONZE 50EC Abamectin Insecticide (25 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml, 1 Litre) ALONZE 50EC is an abamectin insecticide, miticide and nematicide with contact and translaminar action. It controls spider mites, thrips and leaf miners on flowers and vegetables, and nematodes in potatoes. KEY SPECIFICATIONS & FEATURES • Active ingredient: Abamectin 50 g/L • Target: Spider mites in roses and carnations; thrips and leaf miners in vegetables; nematodes in potatoes • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Application settings: Agricultural: flowers, vegetables and potatoes MIXING & APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS 1. Dilution rate: Foliar spray: 0.15 L per hectare in 1000 L of water (3 ml per 20 L). Potato nematodes: soil drench of 240 to 300 ml per hectare in 1000 L of water. 2. Application method: Half-fill the tank with clean water, add the measured product, top up and agitate. Spray in calm weather with good coverage of leaf undersides, where mites and thrips hide. 3. Coverage: depends on the dose and spray volume on the label. Available in 25 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml and 1 Litre. 4. Apply at the first signs of pests, repeat after 7 days, and do not exceed 3 applications. 5. Rotate with products from other groups and keep spray away from streams, ponds and fish. SAFETY & RE-ENTRY PRECAUTIONS • Wear gloves, a mask, goggles, overalls and boots when mixing and spraying. • Pre-harvest interval: chilies, broccoli and snow peas 7 days; runner beans, tomatoes and French beans 3 days; potatoes 14 days. Do not harvest before the interval has passed. • Re-entry period: 12 hours. Keep people, children and animals out of the sprayed area until the spray has dried, and follow the re-entry and pre-harvest intervals on the label. • Keep spray and rinse water away from streams, ponds and wells. Store in the original closed container, cool, dry and locked, away from food and feed. item.title: Bat CRP Bat Repellent 500 ml
item.description: Bat CRP Bat Repellent (500 ml) Bat CRP is a heavy-duty bat repellent chemical for getting rid of bats from roofs, ceilings, halls and other hiding places in homes and buildings. It comes in a 1 litre pack and is diluted with water as directed on the label. KEY FEATURES • Heavy-duty bat repellent • For roofs, ceilings, halls and other roosting places • Dilute with water before use • 1 litre pack • Delivered to all 47 counties THE PROBLEM WITH BATS IN BUILDINGS Bats that settle in a roof or ceiling leave droppings and urine that stain ceilings, cause strong smells and attract insects. Droppings build up in roof spaces, and the noise at night can disturb families, guests and worshippers. Halls, churches, schools, hotels, offices and homes often need a way to move bats out. HOW TO USE IT Dilute Bat CRP with water as directed on the label. For roofing and hall areas, the label dilution is 1 part product to 4 parts water. Apply the diluted mixture to the areas where bats roost, such as the underside of roofs, ceiling spaces, beams and corners. Treat the roosting surfaces thoroughly and repeat if the label advises. Before treatment, clear old droppings and wear protective gear, because dried droppings can create dust. AFTER TREATMENT Once the bats have left, close entry points so that they cannot return. Check the eaves, gaps around the roof, vents and holes in walls and seal them. Clean up droppings safely and keep the roof space dry and clean. Regular inspections help you catch a new problem early. Bats are useful animals outdoors because they eat insects, so the aim is to move them out of buildings rather than harm them. Check local rules on handling bats if you are unsure. SAFETY Read the label before use. Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when mixing and applying, and use a ladder or platform safely when working at height. Wash your hands after use and keep out of reach of children. Keep away from food, water, pets and livestock, and do not let the product reach streams or ponds. STORAGE Store in the original closed container in a cool, dry, locked place. ORDER Order Bat CRP bat repellent online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi.

item.title: Abasi 5% EC 500 ml
item.description: Abasi 5% EC (500 ml) Spider mites, thrips and leafminers are small, but they reduce yield and spoil the look of roses, tomatoes, cucumbers and French beans, which is what buyers pay for. Abasi 5% EC is an abamectin insecticide that kills by contact and stomach action and moves through the leaf (translaminar), so pests feeding on the underside are reached. It works at very low rates. KEY BENEFITS • Strong knockdown of mites and leaf-mining insects • Contact and stomach activity stops pests feeding quickly • Translaminar movement protects both leaf surfaces • Reliable on thrips and other small sucking pests • Cost-efficient: only 4 to 6 ml per 20 L knapsack TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredient: Abamectin 5% (50 g/L) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • IRAC group 6: activates glutamate-gated chloride channels, causing paralysis • Pack: 500 ml (also available in 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml and 1 L) • Crops and pests: thrips, spider mites and nematode dips on roses; spider mites and caterpillars on tomatoes; leafminers and aphids on cucumbers; leafminers, thrips, spider mites and aphids on French beans MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) Rate: 200 to 300 ml per hectare in 1,000 L of water, which is 4 to 6 ml per 20 L knapsack. A 500 ml pack mixes about 83 to 125 knapsacks. 1. Half-fill the knapsack with clean water. 2. Add the measured Abasi, then top up to 20 L and agitate well. 3. Spray immediately after mixing, covering the undersides of leaves where mites and thrips hide. 4. Follow the repeat interval and harvest waiting period printed on your pack. SAFETY Toxic to bees and aquatic life, so avoid spraying during flowering or near water. Wear gloves, mask and overalls. Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying. item.title: #1 Original Actellic 50EC Insecticide 100 ml
item.description: #1 Original Actellic 50EC Insecticide (100 ml) Weevils and moths can turn a full store of maize into dust within months. Actellic 50EC is a fast-acting organophosphate insecticide that kills by contact, ingestion and fumigant action, and it keeps working on walls, floors and bag surfaces after you spray. Farmers, millers and traders use it to protect empty stores, bagged grain and livestock houses. KEY BENEFITS • Rapid knockdown of weevils, beetles, moths, flies and wasps • Residual protection on treated walls, floors and surfaces • Three uses in one bottle: store and surface spray, bagged grain, and grain admixture • Low mammalian toxicity for an insecticide of its class when used as directed • Works through ordinary knapsack and motorised sprayers TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredient: Pirimiphos-methyl 500 g/L (49.02% w/w) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Chemical group: Organophosphate • Targets: weevils, beetles, moths, flies, wasps • Pack: 100 ml MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE • Walls, floors, empty stores, livestock houses: 100 ml in 10 L water (200 ml per 20 L knapsack) • Bagged grain and bag stacks: 50 to 100 ml in 5 L water per 100 m² (200 to 400 ml per 20 L knapsack). Use the higher end for an existing infestation. • Admixture to stored grain: 8 ml per tonne of grain, diluted in 0.75 to 1.5 L water (not mixed in the knapsack) Coverage: about 5 L of spray per 100 m². Porous surfaces such as concrete, brick and unpainted wood may need up to 15 L per 100 m². One 20 L tank covers roughly 400 m² on normal surfaces and about 130 m² on porous ones. 1. Clean and sweep the store first, removing old grain and debris. 2. Spray to wet all surfaces without run-off. 3. Do not use with thermal foggers. SAFETY Organophosphate. Wear gloves, a mask and overalls. Remove food, feed and animals before spraying and ventilate afterwards. Label grain treated by admixture as chemically treated. item.title: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench 5 Litres
item.description: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench (5 Litres) Albafas is a 10% w/v albendazole drench for treating worms and liver fluke in cattle, sheep, goats and camels. It is supplied in a 500 ml bottle from Norbrook Kenya, and it is used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke. KEY FEATURES • 10% w/v albendazole, a broad-spectrum dewormer • For cattle, sheep, goats and camels • Used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke • 500 ml bottle • Made by Norbrook Kenya WHY WORM CONTROL MATTERS Internal parasites quietly drain animals. Heavily infected cattle, sheep, goats and camels grow slowly, lose condition, produce less milk and meat, and become more open to other diseases. Young animals are often the most affected. Regular, well-planned deworming protects growth and productivity and can save the cost of treating sick animals later. HOW TO USE IT Albafas is given by mouth as a drench. The dose depends on the animal species and body weight, so follow the dose on the label and use an accurate drenching gun. Weigh or estimate weight carefully, and dose the heaviest animal in a group at its own weight to avoid under-dosing. Under-dosing is one of the main causes of worms becoming resistant to dewormers. If you are not sure about the dose, the correct time to treat, or the withdrawal period for milk and meat, ask your vet or animal health provider. GOOD PRACTICE • Deworm on a programme agreed with your vet, rather than only when animals look sick • Keep clean water and good pasture management to reduce re-infection • Rotate dewormers from different groups when advised, to help slow resistance • Keep records of dates, products and doses SAFETY AND STORAGE For veterinary use. Follow the label dose and withdrawal periods. Wear gloves when handling and wash your hands afterwards. Keep out of reach of children. Store the bottle tightly closed in a cool, dry place away from direct sun and food. Do not let rinse water reach streams or ponds. KEY FEATURES • 10% w/v albendazole, a broad-spectrum dewormer • For cattle, sheep, goats and camels • Used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke • 500 ml bottle • Made by Norbrook Kenya WHY WORM CONTROL MATTERS Internal parasites quietly drain animals. Heavily infected cattle, sheep, goats and camels grow slowly, lose condition, produce less milk and meat, and become more open to other diseases. Young animals are often the most affected. Regular, well-planned deworming protects growth and productivity and can save the cost of treating sick animals later. HOW TO USE IT Albafas is given by mouth as a drench. The dose depends on the animal species and body weight, so follow the dose on the label and use an accurate drenching gun. Weigh or estimate weight carefully, and dose the heaviest animal in a group at its own weight to avoid under-dosing. Under-dosing is one of the main causes of worms becoming resistant to dewormers. If you are not sure about the dose, the correct time to treat, or the withdrawal period for milk and meat, ask your vet or animal health provider. GOOD PRACTICE • Deworm on a programme agreed with your vet, rather than only when animals look sick • Keep clean water and good pasture management to reduce re-infection • Rotate dewormers from different groups when advised, to help slow resistance • Keep records of dates, products and doses SAFETY AND STORAGE For veterinary use. Follow the label dose and withdrawal periods. Wear gloves when handling and wash your hands afterwards. Keep out of reach of children. Store the bottle tightly closed in a cool, dry place away from direct sun and food. Do not let rinse water reach streams or ponds. ORDER Order Albafas 10% albendazole drench online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi.
